name: online.editclips/mcp
title: EditClips
description: Video, audio, and image processing for AI agents: convert, transcribe, upscale - 150+ operations.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List all available video/audio processing tools with their options

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Create a video/audio processing job. Use list_tools first to find the right tool and options. Returns a job ID — use get_job to check status and get the result URL. Needs a paid plan (Lite or higher). Non-AI results are included in the plan; AI results cost AI credits, charged when the result is ready.

options.description: Tool-specific options (see list_tools for available options)

webhook.description: HTTPS URL to receive a POST when the job completes or fails

durationMs.description: Input duration in milliseconds (for credit estimation)

width.description: Input width in pixels (for credit estimation)

height.description: Input height in pixels (for credit estimation)

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Check the status of a processing job. When status is 'completed', the response includes a download URL valid for 1 hour. An AI result's credits are charged once, when it's ready; if the balance is short the result stays locked and this returns an error saying what's needed — top up, then call get_job again.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued or processing job. A cancelled job costs nothing.
